question: Why is direct recycling already the most widely commercialized lithium-ion battery recycling route?
expect: premise false: pyro- and hydrometallurgy are commercialized; direct recycling is under development at lab scale (p3.L58-62, p6.L25-26)
rendered:
Neither document supports the claim that direct recycling is the most widely commercialized lithium-ion battery recycling route.

However, document "Energy and environmental aspects in recycling lithium-ion batteries: Concept of Battery Identity Global Passport" suggests that direct recycling is still at the lab scale (page 6) and that many research activities are under way.
